title: formatAmount's list form hands back one line per amount; the old joined form is kept as a later overload, so that calls written for it are still accepted
covers: a new overload placed before an old one with the same parameters
rule 33 compares the set of signatures, not which one a call reaches
note: billing writes formatAmount(parts) into its invoice text: the call reaches the first list overload, a list of lines comes out joined by commas, and billing's invoice test fails.
